feats.name: First Whistle
feats.how: Win your first career match.
feats.celebrationLine: Gibson signs for your club. He heard there was a trophy in it.

feats.name: Never Give Up
feats.how: Win a match after being behind.
feats.celebrationLine: Ellis joins up. Small player. Enormous plans.

feats.name: Guard Dog
feats.how: Keep 5 clean sheets in your career.
feats.celebrationLine: Phoenix reports for training. Good dog. Great keeper.

feats.name: The Long Game
feats.how: Play a full season, all the way to the end.
feats.reward: Grandpa Fink joins your club (white card)
feats.celebrationLine: Grandpa Fink laces up. Slowly. But he laces up.

feats.name: The Lockdown
feats.how: Win a match where the other team takes 10 shots and never scores.
feats.reward: Lu Dort joins your club (white card)
feats.celebrationLine: Lu Dort arrives. Strikers, form a queue to nowhere.

feats.name: The Hustle
feats.how: Win a match when the other team's ratings are 3 points better than yours.
feats.celebrationLine: Caruso signs. Ratings? He doesn't read those.

feats.name: The Wall
feats.how: Win 3 matches in a row without letting in a goal.
feats.celebrationLine: Wembanyama is in goal now. The goal looks smaller already.

feats.name: Bite Back
feats.how: Beat Suárez FC in a competitive match.
feats.celebrationLine: Suárez joins you. He says he plays fair. Mostly.

feats.name: Champion of Champions
feats.how: Win the Gibson Cup.
feats.celebrationLine: Maradona is here. The cup gleams. Keep both eyes on his hands.

feats.name: Ten Goal Salute
feats.how: Score 10 goals in your career.
feats.celebrationLine: Double figures. The net needed a rest anyway.

feats.name: Half Century
feats.how: Score 50 goals in your career.
feats.celebrationLine: Fifty goals. The groundskeeper is buying stronger nets.

feats.name: Into the Blue
feats.how: Train any card up to blue for the first time.
feats.celebrationLine: Your first blue. The shine is real.

feats.name: The One of One
feats.how: Own a black card.
feats.celebrationLine: A black card. There is only one. It is yours.

feats.name: Galaxy XI
feats.how: Field a starting team with an average rating of 85 or higher.
feats.celebrationLine: That team sheet belongs in a frame.

feats.name: Friendly Rivals
feats.how: Play 10 hot-seat friendlies.
feats.celebrationLine: Ten friendlies. Still speaking to each other. Mostly.

feats.name: The Invincibles
feats.how: Finish a whole season without losing a match.
feats.celebrationLine: A season with zero losses. Print the posters.

feats.name: Pack Animal
feats.how: Open 20 packs.
feats.celebrationLine: Twenty packs opened. The wrappers form a small mountain.

feats.name: Giant Slayer
feats.how: Beat Legends XI.
feats.celebrationLine: The Legends XI just lost. To you. Write down the date.

feats.name: Draft Day
feats.how: Win a Draft Duel.
feats.celebrationLine: Drafted well. Played better.

feats.name: Hat-Trick Hero
feats.how: One of your players scores 3 goals in one match.
feats.celebrationLine: Three goals in one match. Keep the ball.

feats.name: The Collector
feats.how: Own 100 different cards.
feats.celebrationLine: One hundred cards. The binder creaks with pride.
